thread:
ashley: Heads up — per-route FinOps dashboard shows a big EU on-demand spike overnight, reserved_capacity_utilization dropped 86% -> 42% in last 24h. panel: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/finops/per-route :eyes:
vikram: I see it too. route breakout shows a lot of cost under 'unmapped' for model route summarize-v2. tagging agent might have missed some eu-west1 launches.
tia: Query driving panel (BigQuery snippet):
```sql
SELECT COALESCE(billing_labels.route,'unmapped') AS route, SUM(tokens * unit_price) AS cost
FROM `redwood_billing.billing_export_v2`
WHERE usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY cost DESC
```
Also noticed billing export SKU aliases: some rows have sku = 'NVIDIA:gp5' while reservations are for 'nvidia_a100_80gb' — if SKU normalization mismatches, the reservations won't apply.
alec: Yep — we spun up gp5 pools yesterday (new infra request). Finance reservations in EU are for A100 family; alias mismatch can create a reservation leak.
finops-bot: BillingAlert: Daily forecast vs committed +9% (eu-west1), created FINOPS-1243.
ashley: Can we backfill and re-run allocation pipeline? need a quick mitigation and then a long-term sku normalization.
vikram: I'll open an infra ticket. Quick backfill SQL for allocation table:
```sql
UPDATE `finops.allocations` a
SET route = t.route
FROM `meta.instance_tags` t
WHERE a.instance_id = t.instance_id
  AND a.account_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE();
```
and to recompute costs:
```bash
./bin/run-costs --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-02 --force-recompute
```
tia: Also update Grafana panels to use `billing_labels.route` from billing_export_v2 — current panel references legacy `route` column that's often empty. change the group-by to `IFNULL(billing_labels.route,'unmapped')`.
alec: INFRA-987 opened to normalize SKU aliases and patch the tagger to map gp5 -> nvidia_a100_80gb canonical names. I'll trigger nightly reprocess after patch. ETA today EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ashley: Great. Please post when backfill + recompute done. we need to know if this is a one-off or persistent commit opportunity for EU. cc @sales for potential reserved commit upsell if leak fixed.
ops-robot: Incident logged: incident-2026-03-eu-reservation-gap. Assigned: @vikram, @alec. Priority: P2.
vikram: Also putting a temporary routing policy in place to steer low-priority requests to preemptible dedicated pool to curb immediate on-demand spend.
tia: For posterity, dashboard change to apply: replace FROM `billing_export` with FROM `billing_export_v2` and group by `IFNULL(billing_labels.route,'unmapped')`.
ashley: Thanks team. reconvene after backfill results. anyone see similar in us-west?
alec: No, us-west reservations look stable at ~92% utilization.
ashley: ok — keeping this scoped to eu for now.
